name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST, Approve, Complete (2627 AY), then POST a New Course (2728 AY)
description: Based on apprenticeship-draft-post-ay2627: POSTs a draft apprenticeship starting in the 2627 academic year, approves it via ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent, then SLD PUTs a completion for that course. Finally, SLD POSTs the same learner onto a different, unrelated course starting in the 2728 academic year — exploring how the draft-POST/Progression path behaves when a learner already has a completed apprenticeship and a brand new course arrives via POST rather than a bundled PUT. Exploratory — no assertions yet.
